Title: Windows Universal apps SDK for Azure Mobile Engagement

Body.Content: We have released the Windows Universal apps SDK for the Azure Mobile Engagement service. The SDK is published as a NuGet package, which you can access at the Microsoft Azure Mobile Engagement site. You can import this NuGet package from a Windows Universal app. It will install the correct binaries and other files that are required for you to integrate with Mobile Engagement to monitor the app and receive push notifications. For a detailed Windows Universal Apps tutorial that takes you through all the steps to complete the integration, see Get Started with Azure Mobile Engagement for Windows Universal Apps.
